text: The purpose of this report is to request authority to amend Purchase Order No. 6045108 issued following award of Tender No. 52-2017 to Brook Restoration Limited (Brook Restoration) for "Replacement of Window/Curtain Wall System, Roof System and Safety Anchors at North York Civic Centre - 5100 Yonge Street, Toronto" by the amount of $4,755,900 net of all taxes and charges ($4,839,604 net of HST recoveries). The amendment request is within the overall available and approved Facilities Management Capital Program budget of $16.935 million. The requested amendment is required to enable Facilities Management to add two (2) alternative price items originally included in Tender 52-2017. Facilities Management received competitive pricing on the alternative price items, however, these items were originally excluded due to budgetary limitations at the time of the award. The Government Management Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code (Financial Control By-law), granted authority to amend Purchase Order No. 6045108 issued to Brook Restoration Limited for "Replacement of Window/Curtain Wall System, Roof System and Safety Anchors at North York Civic Centre - 5100 Yonge Street, Toronto" by the additional amount of $4,755,900 net of all taxes and charges ($4,839,604 net of HST recoveries), revising the current Contract value from $10,405,000 to $15,160,900 net of all taxes ($15,427,732 net of HST recoveries).
